The corresponding spec coverage for incremental PATCH updates is also removed. While new dedicated endpoints exist (`put "members" => "groups#add_members"` and `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"`), callers still using the previous PATCH `changes` contract would now be ignored by `update`, so this is a backward-incompatible API change/integration risk rather than an internal correctness bug.
